answer: Treat each identity as a vertex in the evidence graph: when k coordinated identities forge conflicting votes, pairwise links expose up to k(k−1)/2 correlated equivocations, so penalties scale as O(k²). Detection slashes bonded escrows and applies asymmetric capital depreciation; repeated or compounded losses make a sybil swarm’s total capital loss grow exponentially, reaching its zenith when the full cluster is proven.
